events.name: Halloween / Día de Muertos
events.notes: Published early (2026-08-30, ~9 weeks ahead) per explicit request rather than waiting for the 30-day window. No Ahrefs volume for the exact cross-over query yet (too new to be tracked) -- built on the same speculative-but-low-cost logic as contador-de-aura: reuses the existing historia-mx roster/engine (Frida Kahlo, Sor Juana, Zapata, Pancho Villa, etc. already fit Día de Muertos), adds a themed landing article rather than a new duel roster, and folds in Halloween as the same continuous window. Seasonal shareable card idea not built -- the site has no image-generation capability yet, would be a separate feature.
